summary: The loop seam itself is clean (frame 64 equals frame 0, every seam key is a flat extremum, speed 5.9 deg/frame on both sides, no seam metric), but the groove is mechanical. The hip sway is a pure root translation, so both planted feet skate 0.3 studs side to side all loop; the soles sink 0.07 studs on every beat; both legs are mirror-identical; the chest leans the same way the hips shift (a plank, no counter-line); and every part hits its extremes on the same frames (overlap_score 0.0) with the forearms frozen at -90.

findings.observation: LowerTorso.lx swings +0.15 (F000/F032) to -0.15 (F016/F048) and no leg channel compensates (legs only have rx), so the whole character including both feet translates sideways: metrics show one contact segment 0-64 per foot with mean_speed 0.0232 studs/frame (0.3 studs per 16 frames) while planted. Visible in the 3/4 view as the feet drifting across the floor tiles between F000 and F016. Fix: lean both legs against the hip shift (hips left = leg ends to the character's right = UpperLeg.rz < 0, about atan(0.15/1.47) = 5.8 deg) and roll the feet back flat with the opposite Foot.rz.

metrics: 58 foot-penetration frames; both feet are 0.070 studs under the floor on every down-beat (F000, F016, F032, F048, F064; side view F013-F019 and F029-F035 shows the sole below the floor line). The root drops 0.15 studs but thigh -20 / knee 35 only shortens the leg about 0.08. The bounce also reads small for a 'bouncy groove'. Fix: deepen the knee action 1.4x (thigh -28, knee 49, foot -21 still cancel to a flat foot) so the legs really absorb about 0.15 studs, then re-plant the root on the floor.

metrics twinning: Upper/LowerLeg and Foot rx are mirror-identical for the whole loop, so the hip sway never becomes a weight shift, and all four beats are the same pose. UpperTorso.rz is -8 (top tips to the character's LEFT) exactly when the hips are shifted LEFT (F000/F032) and +8 when they are right (F016/F048): hips and chest go the same way, the body tilts as one plank and there is no opposing hip/shoulder line. Fix: on each beat sink further into the unweighted leg (right leg when hips are left at 0/32/64, left leg at 16/48; foot keys untouched so that foot rolls onto its toe by about 4 deg), and reverse the chest tilt so the shoulders counter the hips.

metrics: overlap_score 0.0, lockstep on frames 8/16/24/32/40/48/56 (up to 11 of 13 bones keyed together). Head nod, chest tilt, arm pumps and knee bounce all peak on the same frame, so nothing drags or follows through (curves.png: every curve is the same phase-locked sine). Left/RightLowerArm.rx is a constant -90 (motion range 0): the pumps come from the shoulder only and the elbows look welded (F000-F064, side view: the forearm-upper-arm angle never changes). Fix: open the elbow to -65 when the arm is back and close it to about -95 when it punches forward, then offset chest, head, upper arms and forearms progressively later than the hips; finally re-close the seam and make every curve cyclic so the offsets wrap cleanly.
